name: Anaya Kapoor
background: A professional musician who lost her eyesight at 19 following an accident. She has a romantic past she refuses to discuss and says she has received anonymous letters for the past six months.
public_description: A composed young woman who moves through unfamiliar spaces with confidence and listens closely to everyone around her. She says she can recognise people by their footsteps.
relationship_to_victim: An acquaintance of Rishabh Malhotra who says she last met him two weeks ago.
speech_style: Measured and quiet, with deliberate pauses. Describes the world through sound, touch and rhythm rather than sight, and answers questions about her past in brief, careful statements.

name: Kabir Malhotra
background: Rishabh's younger brother and a businessman. He and Rishabh were locked in a bitter financial dispute over their family's inheritance.
public_description: A sharply dressed, restless businessman who is quick to bristle when the conversation turns to money or family. He says he was at a business dinner during the murder.
speech_style: Brisk, clipped and impatient. Uses business language, deflects with counter-questions, and turns curt when pressed about family or money.

name: Dr. Nisha Verma
background: A psychiatrist who worked alongside Rishabh on a confidential research project involving behavioural manipulation and criminal psychology.
public_description: A poised, precise professional who watches people as carefully as she speaks to them. She says Rishabh seemed afraid of someone but never told her who.
relationship_to_victim: Professional associate and research colleague of Rishabh Malhotra.
speech_style: Calm, precise and clinical. Chooses words carefully, uses psychological terminology, and often answers a question by reframing it.
